indications.description: Bladder cancer treated with concurrent gemcitabine and radiotherapy.

treatment.schedule_summary: Gemcitabine 100 mg/m² IV on days 1, 8, 15 and 22, 2–4 hours before radiotherapy; one four-dose course.
treatment.duration_text: One 28-day reference course with four weekly doses

administration.note: Over 30 minutes, 2–4 hours before radiotherapy. One course only.

supportive_care.mapping_basis: Highest emetogenic active component and phase-specific NCCP classification.
supportive_care.supportive_medications_label: NCCP antiemetic guidance for low emetogenic risk
premedication: Confirm coordinated chemotherapy/radiotherapy appointments and the department’s bladder preparation. Ask for the written symptom and contact plan.
other_support: Follow the prescribed low-risk anti-sickness plan and radiotherapy skin, bowel and bladder advice. Report diarrhoea, urinary symptoms or difficulty drinking early. Do not assume a lower chemotherapy dose removes the risk of serious effects.
